topic: Interior Lighting Sub System - Door Rear Right Lamp Control Commands
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command for controlling the color, brightness, and breathing pattern of the rear right door ambient lamp.

column_semantics.DoorRR3LampColorCmd_1: Command for setting the color of the rear right door ambient lamp
column_semantics.Input: Signal source or interface type (e.g., LIN, RHZCU)
column_semantics.DoorAmbtLampC_RR: Door Ambient Lamp Command for RR
column_semantics.内灯SSTS: Interior Lighting Sub System Technical Specification

core_entities.name: DoorRR3LampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the color of the rear right door ambient lamp using RGB coordinates.

core_entities.name: DoorRR3LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Adjusts the brightness of the rear right door ambient lamp as a percentage.

core_entities.name: DoorRR3LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Configures the breathing (pulsing) pattern of the rear right door ambient lamp with various rates.

core_entities.name: RHZCU
core_entities.description: Right Hand Zone Control Unit responsible for processing commands and controlling the ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network used for sending commands to the RHZCU.

core_conditions.name: Color Value Range
core_conditions.description: 0x00-0xFF for all color values; 0x00 means no request or maintain current color.

core_conditions.name: Brightness Value Range
core_conditions.description: 0x00-0xFF; 0x00 means no request or maintain current brightness.

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate Values
core_conditions.description: 0x00-0x15 represent different breathing rates from 500ms to 4s.

core_outputs.name: DoorAmbtLampC_RR
core_outputs.description: The actual command sent to the rear right door ambient lamp.

core_timing_constraints.name: Breathing Rates
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined rates include 500ms, 1s, 2s, 2.4s, 3s, 3.5s, and 4s for different breathing patterns.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the command structure and parameter ranges for controlling the rear right door ambient lamp's color, brightness, and breathing pattern within the Interior Lighting Sub System. It is used to verify that the RHZCU correctly interprets and applies these commands via the LIN interface.
